traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and listed requirements for docs/stories/001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP.story.md are satisfied.
- Core Functionality: The plugin is implemented as a standard ESLint plugin (default export with rules and configs), built from TypeScript to lib/, and verified by tests/plugin-setup.test.ts. - Quality Standards: The implementation follows ESLint plugin conventions (rules registry, config presets, dynamic rule loading with safe fallback), supported by internal development guides and strict tooling (TypeScript, ESLint, Jest). - Integration with ESLint v9 flat config: src/index.ts exposes flat-config-style presets; eslint.config.js uses the ESLint 9 flat-config format and registers the plugin. CLI integration tests exercise this config and confirm the rules run and produce expected exit codes. - User Experience: README.md and user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md provide clear installation instructions, flat-config setup, quick start, and examples for using the plugin in real projects. - Error Handling: Dynamic rule loading is wrapped in try/catch with clear console errors and a placeholder rule; plugin-setup-error and CLI error-handling tests validate this behavior and all such tests pass. - Documentation: Plugin structure, setup, and development workflow are documented in README, user-docs, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/custom-rules-development-guide.md. - Technical requirements REQ-PLUGIN-STRUCTURE, REQ-ESLINT-COMPAT, REQ-RULE-REGISTRY, REQ-CONFIG-SYSTEM, REQ-NPM-PACKAGE, REQ-TYPESCRIPT, REQ-TEST-SETUP, and REQ-ERROR-HANDLING all have concrete code and passing tests mapped to this story.
Therefore, story 001.0-DEV-PLUGIN-SETUP is fully implemented and passes its acceptance criteria.
